newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST-Danish Nov current account seen in deficit.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Danish Nov current account seen in deficit.

text.p: Eleven international and Danish analysts polled by Reuters foresaw in a survey issued on Monday that Denmark's current account for November 1996 would swing into deficit, with the foreign trade surplus increasing.

The analysts forecast an average current account deficit of 5.2 billion crowns, compared to October's 0.2 billion crown surplus, with estimates swinging from shortfalls of 2.5 billion to 6.5 billion crowns.

The panel foresaw November foreign trade excluding ships at an average surplus of 2.7 billion crowns, against a 2.1 billion crowns surplus in the previous month, with estimates in the 2.0-3.5 billion crown range.
The Danish national statistics office issues the November current account and foreign trade data on Wednesday February 12 at 0830 gmt. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969652
